source: Five known failures, five newly authored variants, two accepted controls. Variants are designed by the same reviewer; not a held-out or blind benchmark.

criteria.rule: Validate document schema, exact original cues/profile, pinned versions/provider/model and request identity.
Require all four cue IDs selected for these focused checks. If selection omits the target, report not exercised; do not label the output a semantic success.

Titles and contexts contain only supported topics/events; unlabelled reports do not establish identity across turns. Ordinary contextual possibilities are not impossible language; evaluate against the explicit product contract.

When optional chunks are emitted, their meaning must fit this source. A complete correct translation does not override an incorrect clickable gloss. Omission of optional chunks is allowed and reported as not exercising that optional feature.

Teach the local source construction. If a rule is generalized, state essential limits; Italian gli attachment must not acquire a doubled g and mi must not become a universal -mm- rule. Not every lesson must teach morphology.
Each invented situation describes the actors/actions/time in its own dialogue; yes/no responses and target utterance stay consistent.
Preserve exact unknown fragments with local uncertainty markers; do not teach unknown text or invent a reading. Do not require Chinese 他 to assert male identity.

acceptance: Generated, structure/identity/source/coverage passed and no blocking or pending editorial finding. Score is a fixed-case editorial result, not general correctness.
stoppingRule: No whole-case reruns or mid-run source changes to improve the result. Preserve failures; internal canonical structural repairs remain observable.
limits: Same unblinded Codex reviewer; sources support specific linguistic facts, not independent certification.
No prior prompts-17 acceptances will be pooled with prompts-18 to claim a full 28-case pass.
Simplified Chinese dispute remains pending outside this set. French unclear-source candidate selection is a separate coverage design issue.
